masses.notes: Implemented projection. Numerical integration tolerances are explicit proposed research settings, not empirical calibration. CDF/W1 admission limits remain unresolved and intentionally fail validation. Grid is all pre-liquidity strikes; clipped tails and placement diagnostics do not supply continuous-distribution coverage or added rho.

rho_calibration.notes: Child audit adapter candidate over shared generic bootstrap/grid owners; tier decision remains G3. Expected-loss candidate uses realized MINUS robust loss; upper mean bound <=0. Template evidence covers only that fixed population, not all MILP-selected trades. Match SP to F^-1(short_q) and SC to F^-1(1-short_q), each at the nearest same-type strike (distance tie lower), longs wing_strikes distinct same-type positions outward; require this node's explicit liquidity params, pinned equal to select base liquidity, standard contract and strict ordering, otherwise missing-template refusal. Payoff-only audit never uses completed-window pricing tiers. Calendar blocks: starts are observed dates; complete [start,start+B) date groups require start+B <= last_observed+1 day; uniform eligible-start sampling with replacement, concatenate until n dates and truncate; no calendar wrap. Before bounding, require every target date to have positive inclusion probability under this exact sampler and at least two distinct supported blocks; otherwise emit unsupported, never a passing bound. A passing bound also requires the full observed-date residual mean <=0. Refuse insufficient min_dates/no complete blocks/degenerate support, retain inclusion counts and full mean. This is an approximate block stress diagnostic, not a finite-sample confidence guarantee. Primary selection only; longer sensitivity reported. Legacy observed-count behavior stays unchanged. Owner approved expected-loss criterion and the finite-grid/smallest-passing procedure; Owner approved direct strike-grid calibration without adding a projection offset; weights remain G3. Projection diagnostics are reported separately, not added to rho. No passing grid value means unsupported, without automatic expansion. Compute fixed-template/radius loss values once per exact forecast/checkpoint/input/grid/payoff/band/numerical identity; rho0 may use nominal expected loss directly. Bootstrap reuses cached residuals, never repeats LP solves. Final candidate review and G1 data gates remain. Owner approved monthly updates using calibration and entry-phase fixed audit-template outcomes, whether or not the optimizer traded. Admit only outcomes settled and published strictly before the configured monthly reference. The rule and template stay frozen; actual selected-trade outcomes do not replace the audit population. Recompute the bound from eligible past residuals, reusing matching loss values; never revise earlier decisions. Every used outcome is published strictly before monthly reference. Emit rho and JSON audit dict (bounds/residuals/blocks/counts/all refusals), consumed by diagnostics. No test-profit selection. Base-template liquidity is unchanged across all sensitivity arms; they reuse the same rho, never recalibrate.

select.notes: Candidate batch adapter runs the eight explicitly declared one-factor arms once; no foreach duplicates them. Tiers use actual calibration-window ticker medians with symbol-rank ties. Own-date VWAP, fee0.65 and haircut assumptions remain research conventions. Calibrated arms refuse null rho; nominal is explicitly a research comparator. All ordered eligible strikes; no cap. Preserves solver certificates, model provenance, holding exclusions and skips.

settle.notes: Implemented child adapter reuses public dskit.production.accounting.WindowBook as sole accounting fold. Preserve raw entry and opposite-side synthetic expiry orders/fills for EACH leg, including zero intrinsic and zero expiry fee; these are evidence records, NOT dskit-eval-v1 events. Fold share-equivalent quantity=contracts*multiplier, USD/share prices and total USD fee (entry fee once per contract, zero expiry fee); never multiply fee again. Instrument is decision-scoped position_id encoding arm/decision/actual contract; retain actual contract and one-lot mapping. Both fills carry fill_label, expiry also labels.exercise. Reuse shared bounded settlement-close rule; later confirming bar itself pre2026. Assert per-position signed quantities end zero and WindowBook.realised equals independent closed-form multiplier*(credit-intrinsic)-entry fees. Do not use leg closes as trade counts. One condor outcome per decision. Evidence retains all raw records, mappings, reconciliation, arm/ticker outcomes/skips; no portfolio return or generic leg-statistic claims.

diagnostics.notes: EXISTS RunReport with stages enabled. Stage labels identify mesh, calibration, selection and settlement. Exhaustive JSON preserves every raw decision/order/fill/solver/outcome/refusal record, diagnostic and reconciliation; Markdown renders stage summaries with its documented row cap and full-JSON pointer. Existing node-scoped artifact writer isolates arms. Condor outcomes are the statistical unit, not leg trips; no portfolio return. Shared base calibration is unchanged across comparison arms.
